name: com.yohash.propulsion.core
description: The Burst-compatible math core of the Propulsion Toolkit, over Unity.Mathematics. StablePd matches a target position or rotation (1, 2 or 3 axes) with a physically parameterized response (frequency in Hz, damping ratio), solved exactly for the physics engine's integrator, including sub-stepping engines, and unconditionally stable. Pid provides a bounded throttle with an integral term. No dependency on UnityEngine physics, Entities or any physics package.
